groups.operation: Parse and render a spoiler span through md_html.
groups.condition: MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set and the input contains ||text||.
groups.capability: Recognize double-pipe delimiters and emit x-spoiler tags.
groups.consequence: The spoiler span is not rendered as a spoiler.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: no other candidate concerns spoiler parsing and rendering.

groups.operation: Retain HTML chunks emitted by the md_html output callback.
groups.condition: md_html invokes the harness output callback.
groups.capability: Store emitted chunks for later inspection.
groups.consequence: Emitted HTML is unavailable for later inspection.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: output retention is distinct from spoiler parsing and rendering.
